items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1959-08-11
items.q: Then I came in behind Coochie Morton and I played a while.

ctx.x: His brother was a drummer, wasn't he? Yeah, yeah. Henry Morton. Henry Morton. After he got... After Coochie Morton... Coochie Morton stayed with him a long time. Then, after Coochie Morton left, fell out or something, broke away from him. Then I came in behind Coochie Morton and I played a while. I didn't play long. And right after I left, he got Bud Scott.
Oh yeah. I knew Bud Scott.
